notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Changes

We have a small balance of end game and weapon tiers update. 
Hopefully this will lead to a more balanced experience in 1st and 2nd Class. 

• All weapon tiers are now closer to each other in damage output, especially T2, 3 and 4 
• T3 Armor has a slight reduction in HP 
• T4 weapons can't be repaired anymore 
• Contraband black market prices are more expensive and it has only T3 Rifles 
• Conductors have now 5 maximum lives 
• T4 weapon printer in the Engine Control room is now located only in the Engine Vault

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f4def0e53915859951633b5f961a2f6e13bb1fb7.png"]

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Critical changes

Big shifts are coming — and they’ll change how you climb through the Classes, how you survive, how you fight, and how you build. This isn’t just balance tuning. This is a fundamental evolution of the Train. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f39f-fe0f.png"] Class Registration Gets Serious 
No more hopping around between Classes without a pass. 
• Upper airlocks to 2nd and 1st Class now require a matching Class Ticket. 
• You can craft these tickets at the general crafter. 
• The Undercarriage airlock? That one’s simple: just break the barrier — opening the airlock itself is free. Time to earn your seat in the upper decks. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f480.png"] Limited Lives 2.0 — Redemption & Karma 
Lives just became a tradable, redeemable resource — and a moral choice. 
• Passenger Chips can now be used to redeem lives. 
• Anyone can redeem a chip, but the life goes to the chip’s owner or their party. 
• Redeem a stranger’s chip? You gain +3 positive karma. 
◦ Yep, you can now become the saints of the Train. 
• And yes, you can still sell chips for solid profit if that’s more your style. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9ea.png"] 3rd Class Economy & Combat Tweaks 
Things just got more scarce — and more intense — in 3rd Class. 
• Chemicals are now very rare. 
• T1 weapons are a bit more expensive to craft. 
• Pistol and SMG ammo cost more. 
• Harpoon ammo now requires chemicals. 
• Base upkeep no longer uses chemicals (good news!). 
• T1 pistol is now the default weapon in crafting stations. 
• Once you reach 2nd Class, you can’t return to 3rd via airlocks — only via respawn. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4e6.png"] 3rd Class Supply Drops Got an Upgrade 
They're no longer filled with scraps — this time, you might strike gold. 
• Supply drops now include top-tier mining equipment. 
• You might even find a T4 hammer or a legendary drill in there. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9f1.png"] Train Wall HP Buff

Fortifying just got more meaningful. 
• All train walls now have 15,000 HP. 
• Compartment carriages are now a fast and easy way to build a base: 
           ◦ Just place a foundation and a door. 
• Add reinforcements and they become seriously safe — unless you’re hit with proper raiding gear. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6aa.png"]C8 Exit Airlock Enhancements 
No more wandering around confused: 
• We’ve added new visual and audio cues to guide you out of C8. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3af.png"] Max Lives by Class — Risk and Reward 
Higher Classes now come with higher stakes: 
• 3rd Class: 20 lives 
• 2nd Class: 15 lives 
• 1st Class: 10 lives 
• Conductors: 10 lives 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6e0-fe0f.png"] Engine Vault Fixes & Rewards 
Cracking the Vault is now worth it — just be prepared. 
• Vault Card now has 25 uses — check durability. 
• Loot crates now contain a selection of very generous rewards. 
• Make space in your inventory before opening — don’t let full bags ruin your haul. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a3.png"] Grenade Damage Balance 
Booms are still powerful — just not base-wiping powerful. 
• All grenades now deal less structural damage. 
• It now takes ~30 T3 grenades to destroy a T3 wall. 
• T1 demolition charge got a buff — the rest remain unchanged. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6e1-fe0f.png"] Safe Zones Tweaked 
A bit safer. A bit cleaner. 
• All safe zone exits now have sliding doors. 
• Fixed poking/clipping issues on doors and airlocks. 
• A countdown before reapplying safe zone effects is coming soon. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f383.png"] Pumpkin Patch Fixes 
Yes. Pumpkins. 
• Grown pumpkins now yield the same amount as those in the botanical carriage. 
• Their yield is Class-specific — best resources only grow in 1st Class.



[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9f7.png"] Other Changes Worth Knowing 
• Batteries can now be crafted in 3rd Class. 
• Cargo carriages have more building space (more improvements soon). 
• Mining charges deal more damage to structures and players. 
• Base upkeep doesn’t use chemicals anymore, but will be more expensive in the future. 
• 2nd Class Ticket is cheaper to craft and doesn’t need chemicals — still takes 5 minutes though. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f686.png"] A New Era of Strategy, Risk, and Reward 
This update changes how you play, how you climb, and how you survive. Choose your Class. Redeem or profit. Build or raid.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f4def0e53915859951633b5f961a2f6e13bb1fb7.png"]

notes.title: REDS & BLUES
notes.content:
Critical changes

• Tutorial ❓
    ◦ Every new player will now go through simple tutorial level, which teaches the basics of the game
    ◦ After completion, players are moved into the Train

• Rare Samples  💰
    ◦ They can be found in meganodes, nodes and trashnodes with higher rarity in every next Class
    ◦ Engine Control room contains a T3 Rare Sample dispenser which works only if there is a Conductor
    ◦ They can be sold in higher Class for Credits in Sell and Go shop or Syncs at the Dagger terminals in 2nd and 1st Class Compartment undercarriages
    ◦ T1 Rare Sample sells for 10 000 Credits and 5 Syncs, T2 Rare Sample for 20 000 Credits and 10 Syncs and T3 Rare Sample for 35 000 Credits and 15 Syncs
    ◦ Syncs can be used in Sync Shops for T3 blueprints and legendary gear

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/ce7347cb8fd309e323c2e1d780d686480d199714.png

• Recoil system work 💥
    ◦ New system that allows for better control of defining spray patterns
    ◦ Recoil recovery will bring your aim back to where the firing started, should feel intuitive.
    ◦ Basic recoil implemented on all weapons, iterations will happen

• Sync leaderboards 🔁 
    ◦ All Mall areas of Compartment carriages have now a leaderboard which shows the player with most Syncs in their wallet

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/bf1a65cda5417d94359e9bbc7076cb629c7a79e8.png

• Botanical T1 Rare Samples growing🌲
    ◦ Some plants in Botanical carriage can now grow T1 Rare Samples!
    ◦ You will either need a full farm or to hunt for bandit and virtue ears

• New Resource models 💎
    ◦ Feast your eyes on the new pickup and resource models!

• Weapon changes 🧨
    ◦ All Demolition Charges are now far more expensive both when buying and crafting
    ◦ T3 Armor can be now bought and crafted
    ◦ Armor buffed at all tiers with +25 points
    ◦ Various alignment and ADS fixes and tweaks
    ◦ Various animation fixes, shotgun has a new jump animation
    ◦ Iron sight on rifle model has been aligned better

◦ New improvised SMG model 🔫
    ◦ Spread on hipfire has been adjusted on various weapons

• Various Changes
    ◦ All locked chests have now only 3 digit pincodes
    ◦ Last ear is now a Passenger Chip, the functionality is the same
    ◦ Advertisement boards and arrows on the ground light up and show the state of a class breach happening in your carriage. (doesn't work with engine breach yet)
    ◦ Contracts have digital currency reward now

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/bc87486c9f1f0136d288395fe2c83555d547f3d3.png

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2437390/extras/joinOurDiscord_01__1_.png?t=1702742899

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Critical changes

• Gear purge exceptions🪛
    ◦ Starter gear is now excluded from gear purge in the starter carriage
    ◦ As a special experiment also all T1 gear, including weapons, excluding explosives will also not be purged

• Revolution train structure 🚂 
    ◦ Train has now final structure of: border, compartment and landmark carriage
    ◦ First class has now a border carriage for breach counter mayhem and the last carriage before the engine is now botanical

• Botanical carriage 2.0🌲
    ◦ Did you ever want to live a crazy bloodthirsty hermit in a jungle and ambush anybody going through your territory? Say no more!
    ◦ They layout and foliage has been changed to enable all your jungle ambush fantasies especially favoring solos or small groups
    ◦ For now just the layout pass has been done, far more foliage will be added next week

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/218cb5194ed12ddedbb26ca7eafc643b0e2a245d.png

• Weapon pass 🔫
    ◦ T1 Rifle has been removed. The Harpoon now fulfills its role instead.
    ◦ All weapons within their respective archetypes have been aligned with each other in terms of stats. A tier upgrade today only means larger magazine. More factors will be tweaked in the future. (Legendaries do a bit more damage).
    ◦ Spread on all guns overhauled with the intent of feeling better. Spread is one of the stats within archetypes that is the same between tiers.
    ◦ Recoil standardized within archetypes and are the same between tiers.
    ◦ Move speed modifiers on weapons have been modified.
    ◦ Grenades have been nerfed a bit
    ◦ Demolition Charges & C4 Charges now do less demolition damage so they take more to destroy structures.

• Starter carriage changes 🆕
    ◦ New layout funneling players to important tutorial elements
    ◦ More Train Information Boards throughout the Carriage
    ◦ Better visibility of objectives
    ◦ Removed some crafting stations to reduce noise

• Shopping malls 🛒
    ◦ Second and third class compartment carriages have now a dedicated shopping mall corners

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/bde8f8bbc92024436d963e869c322c77cfe926a5.png

• Weaker pincode Engineroom Airlock 🔏
    ◦ The Engineroom pincoded airlock has now only 3 digits!
    ◦ The decoder is again in the game, so make the best use of it

• New turret models 🖼️
    ◦ T1  turret has a new improvised turret model
    ◦ T2 and T3 have now the super cool gattling turret model. Balance changes to represent the visuals properly will come later

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/8ddcaf7894ba228bb40b449a1784d197a756ef18.png

• Legendary drill 🥁
    ◦ If you have Syncs to spare, you can now buy a legendary drill in the Sync shops

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/b241a545db48f2f95adbb80fadda271e21391ac2.png

• New T1 window animation 🪟
    ◦ Window animation changed. Now it opens and closes completely, which is great for shooting raiders or anyone.

• Blue blueprint crates 🗺️
    ◦ Blueprints can be now found in their own special blue crates

• Various updates
    ◦ Class and Engine breachers can be bought in gear shops
    ◦ Respawn live costs is far cheaper now
    ◦ Chicken roulette corners are gone, we all will miss the train rave!
    ◦ Caravan event is now in the trench instead of cargo
    ◦ Contract stations distributed across the whole train

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2437390/extras/joinOurDiscord_01__1_.png?t=1702742899

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Critical changes

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Critical changes

• Conductor evaluation 🤠 
    ◦ Engine has a new game loop: the Conductor evaluation cycle
    ◦ Cycle is now set to every 15 minutes
    ◦ Any Conductor who is able to keep their title during this cycle will get reward: new currency called Sync
    ◦ Syncs will be soon usable in special shops, but down the line will be essential for upgrades and progression, even getting your own train
    ◦ At the end of the evaluation cycle Conductors can decide either to bank the reward and restart or continue next cycle and double the reward
    ◦ If anybody steals the Conductor title during the evaluation cycle they steal also half of Syncs of the previous Conductor

• Spectator mode 📸
    ◦ After a team member looses all their lives and the rest of the party is still alive they switch to a spectator mode
    ◦ It's possible to leave the party and restart the revolution cycle alone

• Shorter train 🚅
    ◦ Train is two carriages shorter: 2nd and 1st Class border carriages were removed
    ◦ The Hangar and Botanical Carriage serve now as the battlefield to counter breaching trespassers
    ◦ Class registration terminals are located in the up part of the front of each carriage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/2ac5ceab4fafba3264de54f8eb359a61c8323790.png

• New starter playground carriage with timed airlock 🛝
    ◦ There is a new carriage with a special timed airlock
    ◦ The timed airlock opens every 5 minutes and stays open for 2 minutes
    ◦ Starter playground carriage has plenty of resources and crafting stations to allow players to experiment and learn the game systems

• Firearm setup 2.0  🔫
    ◦ Arsenal wide overhaul of time to kill
    ◦ Arsenal wide overhaul of ADS

• New Engine carriage 🚂
    ◦ Brand new Engine carriage with an actual engine!
    ◦ Engine breach door was moved to the entry of the Engine room
    ◦ Poison gas was removed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/59748bdead0edf7f89705ef9d08094f6a314dec5.png

• Various balance changes ⚖️
    ◦ More cheaper breachers, both in crafting and shops
    ◦ Less respawns
    ◦ More metal in all compartment carriages

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2437390/extras/joinOurDiscord_01__1_.png?t=1702742899

• Limited lives

        ▪︎ Registration in 3rd Class: 5 lives
        ▪︎ Registration in 2nd Class: 5 lives

    ◦ Eating a trespasser ear grants 1 live too!

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Critical changes

Actual changes are too numerous to list them all, so here are just the most critical ones

• New Class structure 🫂
    ◦ Every class start with a landmark carriage, then has a compartment carriage made for basebuilding
    ◦ Second and Third carriages have a border carriage which is used during breaches

• Breach 2.0  🔐 
    ◦ Every class border has now an airlock which needs to be breached by a special quantum breacher
    ◦ This is possible only in the maintenance window, which has its own timing for all classes, look on the airlock and timer boards for more info
    ◦ You need to place the breacher on the airlock in the maintenance window, if you place it before it's not going to start the breaching sequence
    ◦ Breachers can be purchased or crafted

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/36d2a7b5fb74f3a3cc6438ba825a0714e4227bf4.png

• New Landmark carriages 🚅
    ◦ Junkiard is the first carriage passengers will see. It's possible to build limited structures here and learn the basics of the game
    ◦ Dagger Airlock carriage is used to access the dagger airlocks and host the caravan event

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/5dce8fd5e099b3b7b55d1494e06913740f4e1508.png

• Crafting and resource distribution changes 🥘
    ◦ Metal is now the starting basic resource
    ◦ Nitrates can be now accessed from beginning of the game because they are required for ammo crafting
    ◦ Basebuilding is cheaper but uses more types of resources

• Basebuilding carriages 🏗️ 
    ◦ A lot of the carriages can't or have limited use for basebuilding (border carriages, Dagger Hangar, Junkyard)
    ◦ Compartment carriages are designed for hosting bases both in having access to resources and facilities like shops and ATMs

• Class blueprint sets 🗺️

    ◦ Beware that some ears have lowering price every next time you sell them

    🔹 You can craft new "speed up" boots and repulsor boots make you jump higher!

• Gas mask 0.5 - face wrap 🎭
    🔹 Wanna do a quick run in the undercarriage but don't have a gas mask? Don't despair anymore and use your trusty face wrap
    🔹 It doesn't protect you completely but allows for quick runs

• Class airlock access 🚪
    🔹 All undercarriage airlocks within one class can be now accessed freely
    🔹 All train airlocks down the train of your class can be accessed without any kind of card or ticket
    🔹 Going back you still need to go through the breach sequence

• Food 🥙
    🔹 No need to go to the undercarriage for raw food, it can be found also on ground floor
    🔹 Just search for disgusting moldy corners, enjoy scavenging!

• Resources ⛏️
    🔹 There are more "leaking pipes", which drop resources. Serve the Train, clean it up and profit!

• Combat ⚔️
    🔹 Damage and range of C4 was increased
    🔹 T1 weapon damage was buffed
    🔹 SMGs were buffed

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
This build uses train builder, which is deep architectural change essential for future trains. Although it's a historical moment, expect some technical anomalies. Thank you for understanding.

Critical changes

Remote Demolition charge 💥 
🔹 You can now craft and buy the detonator and Remote Demolition Charge
🔹You can place as many charges as you want and then detonate them with the detonator using the radial menu
🔹 Pro tip: you can place demo charges also on other players!

Door Death 🚪 
🔹 Currently still with friendly fire turned off, but your enemies can still get a nasty surprise by being oneshot if you catch them in a closing door
🔹 You can toggle both autoclose and safety on individual doors
🔹 Protip: you can manually close the doors also on your friends!

Trash nodes 🍯 
🔹 For all you undercarriage rats the Train has a surprise: trash nodes, which are mined as nodes in the resource platform
🔹 Trash nodes give you a random selection of resources, you might be luck and hit the sweet tritium jackpot!

Economy setup 💸 
🔹 It's not possible to buy T2 and T3 weapons anymore, anywhere!
🔹 This is to give crafting its value and edge

Crafting setup 🛠️ 
🔹 You know now more default blueprints and crafting prices were discounted - including ammo, praise the Conductors!
🔹 Also slingshot has returned into player crafting

Engine breach 🚄
🔹 The first "free" engine breach is gone for now, you will need always a quantum decoder now
🔹There are no respawn points in the carriage anymore

Food and drinks 🍖 
🔹Prices are higher and food is less common in the undercarriage
🔹We really recommend to setup a cooking station or steal some cooked meals of someone

Peacekeeper turrets 🕊️ 
🔹Their damage is lower now and they protect only critical places like shops and refiners

Experiments
Bedrolls are not expensive anymore, but need metal

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Hydration and nutrition are back online with all the positive and negative effects. Passengers of lower classes will need to get creative with cooking, because hydration gel and nutribars are very expensive. Higher classes can consider cooking a hobby... 🍖 🚰 

Burn rate is set so you have to deal with it two or three times during our playtests, if you don't want the benefits that is! 
State of need bars is remembered after respawn (rounding up to 10s)

Hydration  💧 
🔹 Keeping hydration to 90% will give you a slight heal over time (one tick is 0.5 hp, so the HP bar will update every second tick)
🔹Getting hydration to 0% will give you the same rate, but damage over time. It's not going to kill you, but will create a pressing situation
🔹Someone has a stretchgoal to hook up hydration to sprinting, so let us wish him luck 🤞 

Nutrition  🥩 
🔹 Burns little slower then hydration
🔹 If you keep it above 90% you will get a 15% bonus HP
🔹 Getting nutrition under 50% will lower your max HP to 75, under 25% to 50 HP
🔹 Nutrition will be later used in encumbrance and carry capacity

Part of this rebalance pack is also healing rate of food. Hospitality highly recommends to try them. Especially ear pie is a mighty combat stimulant, because it gives a considerably long heal over time, which with a full hydration and nutrition bar can be a considerable advantage 👂 

The Train provides 🚂
